# deps: tools: up esbuild to v0.14.53

Pin `esbuild` at v0.14.53 in the Go toolset, following [[DOT-369]] (v0.14.52) the same day. `esbuild` is a JS bundler kept in the toolset; the upgrade is a change of the pin in [toolset/go.mod](../../toolset/go.mod), installed via [tools.go](../../toolset/tools.go). The release notes are the [v0.14.53 tag](https://github.com/evanw/esbuild/releases/tag/v0.14.53).
